# DubbingBase Website

> DubbingBase is a comprehensive platform dedicated to tracking and managing dubbing information for movies and TV shows. It serves as a database for voice actors, their roles, and the productions they are involved in.

This website provides a web interface for the DubbingBase platform, featuring data grids and analytics.

## Features

- [Home](https://dubbingbase.com/) - Explore movies, TV shows, and voice actor profiles.
- [About](https://dubbingbase.com/about) - About DubbingBase.
- [Terms](https://dubbingbase.com/terms) - Terms of Service.
- [Privacy](https://dubbingbase.com/privacy) - Privacy Policy.
- [Guidelines](https://dubbingbase.com/guidelines) - Community Guidelines.

## API

A token-authenticated REST API (voice actors, cast credits, game characters, advertisements and toys) is available for admins. Create a token under Profile → API Key, then send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The OpenAPI description explains the workflow for maintaining credits: find the voice actor, read existing credits and characters, preview a batch with `?dry_run=true`, then write it (all or nothing). The API never calls media providers, so media must already exist on DubbingBase.

- [OpenAPI spec](https://dubbingbase.com/api/v1/openapi.json) - Machine-readable description of every endpoint, scope and schema.
- [API docs](https://dubbingbase.com/api/v1/docs) - Interactive reference for humans.
- [API catalog](https://dubbingbase.com/.well-known/api-catalog) - RFC 9727 discovery document.
